sourceText: Build the narrowing-only evidence re-pin story (E) after the single-owner extraction and test-and-guard stories, and carry it to DONE.
normalizedOutcome: Every verification receipt records the selector it was judged against and checklist_get exposes it; a pinned selector can be replaced only when receipts the tool itself recorded prove the new selector strictly narrower, with both pins, both receipts, a reason and the cited receipt ids retained; loosening, a missing recorded failing render, and a second narrowing against unchanged receipts are each refused with their own message.
acceptanceClaim: node packages/main/dist/tasks/narrowing-repin-smoke.js ends with narrowing-repin-smoke: PASS, covering the persisted selector, the accepted narrowing proved from recorded receipts, each refusal case, the rejection of caller-supplied transcripts, and the replay of the B-a745 CHK-005:happy:0 shape, with a RED commit preceding every implementation commit.
